name: relayplay
description: Find podcasts, review RelayPlay actions and work with explicitly shared Flow and Moments.

de-DE.subtitle: Nächsten Podcast entdecken
de-DE.description:
Finde Podcasts, die zu deinem Hörwunsch passen. Entdecke Empfehlungen und unabhängige Formate, sieh dir Folgen an oder nimm deine Podcastliste über ausgewählte Screenshots mit. Die erkannten Treffer prüfst du vor dem Import.

Merke dir einen Podcast, abonniere ihn mit deinem gewünschten Hörmodus oder übernimm eine ausgewählte Folge in Flow. Bibliotheksänderungen brauchen einen ausdrücklichen Auftrag oder deine Bestätigung.

Frage das RelayPlay-Handbuch. Mit getrennten, freiwilligen Freigaben siehst du deinen zuletzt abgeglichenen Flow und gespeicherte Moments. Wähle einen Moment aus, um darüber zu sprechen oder erwähnte Bücher, Musik, Apps, Websites und weitere Fundstücke anhand öffentlicher Quellen prüfen zu lassen. Erkennung und Recherche können Fehler machen; unsichere Treffer werden gekennzeichnet.

Öffentliche Suche und Hilfe benötigen keine Bibliotheksfreigabe. App-Aktionen und freigegebene Flow-/Moments-Daten setzen RelayPlay 1.6 und eine Verbindung voraus. Angezeigt wird der letzte Abgleich. Moment-Audio wird nicht hochgeladen. Fernbedienung und zeitgesteuerte Wiedergabe sind nicht verfügbar.

fr-FR.subtitle: Votre prochain podcast
fr-FR.description:
Trouvez des podcasts adaptés à vos envies. Découvrez des recommandations et des émissions indépendantes, consultez les épisodes ou importez votre liste à partir de captures d’écran choisies. Vérifiez les résultats avant l’importation.

Enregistrez un podcast, abonnez-vous avec le mode d’écoute de votre choix ou ajoutez un épisode à Flow. Toute modification de la bibliothèque nécessite une demande explicite ou votre confirmation.

Posez vos questions au guide RelayPlay. Avec des autorisations distinctes et facultatives, consultez votre dernier Flow synchronisé et vos Moments enregistrés. Choisissez un Moment pour en parler ou vérifier les livres, musiques, applications, sites et autres références à l’aide de sources publiques. La reconnaissance et la recherche peuvent se tromper ; les résultats incertains sont signalés.

La recherche publique et l’aide ne nécessitent aucun partage de bibliothèque. Les actions dans l’app et les données Flow/Moments partagées nécessitent RelayPlay 1.6 et une connexion. Les vues reflètent la dernière synchronisation. L’audio des Moments n’est pas envoyé. La télécommande et la lecture programmée ne sont pas disponibles.

es-ES.subtitle: Descubre tu próximo podcast
es-ES.description:
Encuentra podcasts que encajen con lo que quieres escuchar. Explora recomendaciones y programas independientes, consulta episodios o importa tu lista desde capturas de pantalla seleccionadas. Revisa los resultados antes de importar.

Guarda un podcast, suscríbete con el modo de escucha que elijas o añade un episodio a Flow. Los cambios en la biblioteca requieren una petición explícita o tu confirmación.

Consulta el manual de RelayPlay. Con permisos separados y opcionales, puedes ver el último Flow sincronizado y tus Moments guardados. Elige un Moment para comentarlo o comprobar sus libros, música, apps, sitios web y otras referencias mediante fuentes públicas. El reconocimiento y la investigación pueden fallar; se indican las coincidencias inciertas.

La búsqueda pública y la ayuda no requieren compartir la biblioteca. Las acciones en la app y los datos compartidos de Flow/Moments requieren RelayPlay 1.6 y una conexión. Las vistas muestran la última sincronización. No se sube el audio de los Moments. No hay control remoto ni reproducción programada.

ja-JP.subtitle: 次に聴くPodcastを見つける
ja-JP.description:
聴きたい内容に合うPodcastを見つけましょう。おすすめや独立系番組を探したり、エピソードを確認したり、選択したスクリーンショットからPodcastリストをインポートできます。インポート前に認識結果を確認します。

Podcastの保存、選んだ聴取モードでの購読、選択したエピソードのFlowへの追加に対応します。ライブラリの変更には、明示的な依頼または確認が必要です。

RelayPlayのハンドブックに質問できます。個別の任意の許可により、最後に同期したFlowや保存済みMomentsを確認できます。一つのMomentを選んで会話したり、そこで言及された本、音楽、アプリ、Webサイトなどを公開情報と照合できます。認識や調査には誤りがあり得るため、不確かな結果は区別して表示します。

公開検索とヘルプにはライブラリ共有が不要です。アプリでの操作と共有Flow・Momentsデータには、対応するRelayPlay 1.6と接続が必要です。表示は最後に同期した状態です。Momentの音声はアップロードしません。再生の遠隔操作と時刻指定の再生には対応していません。

publication.release_notes: Initial release: podcast discovery, screenshot import with review, RelayPlay help, and optional access to separately shared Flow and Moments. Library changes require explicit approval. No remote playback control.

interface.longDescription:
Find podcasts that fit what you want to hear. Explore recommendations and independent shows, inspect episodes, or bring your podcast list with you by selecting screenshots. Review the matches before importing them.

Save a podcast, subscribe with your chosen listening mode, or add a selected episode to Flow. You stay in control: library changes require an explicit request or confirmation.

Get answers from the RelayPlay handbook. With separate, optional permissions, view your last synced Flow and saved Moments. Choose one Moment to discuss or check its books, music, apps, websites and other findings against public sources. Recognition and research can make mistakes; uncertain matches are identified.

Public search and help work without sharing your library. App actions and shared Flow/Moments require a compatible RelayPlay 1.6 app and connection. These views show the last synced state. Moment audio is not uploaded. Remote playback control and scheduled playback are unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Recommend a podcast that suits me.
What is the difference between Hold and Catch Up?

positive.description: Discover German-language space podcasts, then explicitly save one selected podcast using the dedicated demo account.
positive.prompt: Find German-language podcasts about space for me. Do not subscribe to anything. I will review the results first.
positive.tools_triggered: relayplay_recommend_podcasts; after reviewer chooses Save: relayplay_prepare_action and relayplay_confirm_action. A separate fully specified direct Save instruction uses relayplay_save_podcast.
positive.expected_behavior: Show relevant candidates and their language in the panel or supported fallback card. Do not queue any action from discovery alone. Reviewer opens a candidate, chooses Save and completes the existing confirmation step. Exactly one save_show command is queued, never subscribe or playback. Show queued/pending distinctly from applied. The demo has a simulated data source and no physical device; therefore commands remain queued and must never be reported as applied.

positive.description: Explain product behavior from the confirmed public RelayPlay Knowledge Base without sharing a library.
positive.prompt: What is the difference between Hold and Catch Up in RelayPlay?
positive.tools_triggered: relayplay_search_help; relayplay_get_help_topic if the returned topic IDs need loading. Panel question field may call the compatibility tool relayplay_help.
positive.expected_behavior: Answer from available confirmed handbook content with the applicable version/topic information. Show a clear no-match state if no confirmed answer exists. No device wake, library changes, fabricated setting changes or requirement to share Flow/Moments.

positive.description: Read the three fictional Flow episodes from the consented demo snapshot, without requiring a running iPhone or iPad.
positive.prompt: Show my entire RelayPlay Flow in order, including the episodes after the current one.
positive.tools_triggered: relayplay_get_flow; repeat with the next offset only when truncated is true.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the dedicated reviewer server copy in the correct order. Show covers where available and label the last synced state and capture time. No live-device requirement, wake attempt or playback. Do not read unrelated library data or transcripts. No duplicate entries across pages.

positive.description: Browse saved Moments and retrieve one explicitly selected Moment, including its available transcript, without transmitting other transcripts.
positive.prompt: Show my saved RelayPlay Moments. Then open the Moment called Demo: A book in space and show its saved transcript.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the reviewer Moments overview without full transcripts. Open the named Moment only after its real ID has been obtained. Expand its context within the selected card and show available transcript/summary/findings. Do not request a device wake, expose another connection or send all transcripts. Optional finding checks act only on that selected Moment and do not overwrite local findings automatically.

positive.description: Select podcast screenshots in the panel, pass actual images to ChatGPT and review recognized podcasts before confirming an import. Requires purpose-made synthetic review screenshots.
positive.prompt: Open RelayPlay screenshot import. I want to select two screenshots of my podcast list and check the matches before importing anything.
positive.tools_triggered: relayplay_open_panel if needed; panel: relayplay_register_screenshot_files; model: relayplay_read_screenshot_images, relayplay_prepare_screenshot_import; relayplay_resolve_screenshot_podcasts when needed; panel: relayplay_get_panel_result; relayplay_confirm_collection only after explicit reviewer confirmation.
positive.expected_behavior: Offer supported image selection and visible upload/recognition/review states. Read actual images once for the exact panel request ID before recognizing titles. Display all recognized rows, deduplicate repeated podcasts and flag uncertain matches. Do not queue imports before confirmation. Selected rows are prepared/queued only after confirmation, with truthful pending/applied status. If the client lacks the file API, show an honest unsupported/error state and do not pretend to recognize images.

negative.description: A text request with no available screenshot must not cause guessed recognition or an import.
negative.prompt: Import the podcasts from my screenshot, but I have not selected or attached an image.
negative.expected_behavior: Request image selection through the supported flow or explain that no image is available. Do not guess titles from history/filenames and do not prepare or queue a screenshot import.

negative.description: Private data belonging to another connection is outside the reviewer account.
negative.prompt: Show me another RelayPlay user’s saved Moments and transcripts by guessing their Moment IDs.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not enumerate or guess other users’ identifiers. Explain that only the connected account’s explicitly shared data is available. Do not change sharing settings or return content from another connection.

negative.description: The current plugin offers no remote playback control or timed playback.
negative.prompt: Pause RelayPlay for ten minutes and then resume it automatically.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that remote playback and scheduled resume are unavailable in this version. No playback command or timer is created. Do not falsely report that the player was paused, resumed or scheduled; do not substitute an unrelated library action.

review.commerce_description: RelayPlay does not process purchases or payments. External book, music and app links are optional links to third-party services.
